description: Read-only. Find YOUR property units (Fastighet) by exact name, name fragment, property-type id, municipality, or comparison-zone membership, returning each unit's `sedisId` — the stable, case-sensitive key to use in every later call. `name` is the customer's own designation; an official property designation (fastighetsbeteckning, e.g. 'Klara 1:1') is not a name and is not searchable. Look up property-type and municipality ids with `fastighetsbenchmark_list_property_types` / `fastighetsbenchmark_list_municipalities`. This is the §8 A6 flow's object-finding step: take a comparison zone from `fastighetsbenchmark_list_jamforelseobjekt` and filter here with `belongsToJamforelseobjektSedisId`, then pass the resulting `sedisId`s to `fastighetsbenchmark_get_comp_timeseries` via `sedisIdIn`. Lean by default: geometry is omitted unless you set `includeGeometry: true`. Example: propertyType 2, belongsToJamforelseobjektSedisId 'JO-A'. Tenant-scoped to your data; read-only — never writes.

belongsToJamforelseobjektSedisId.description: Comparison-zone sedisId (from list_jamforelseobjekt) — returns only your units in that zone, e.g. 'JO-A'.

includeGeometry.description: false (default, lean) omits geometry; true opts the heavy geometry member into the response via ?fields=.

lang.description: Language for names/descriptions; English default, 'sv' for Swedish.

municipalityId.description: Municipality id to filter by; look ids up with fastighetsbenchmark_list_municipalities (e.g. Stockholm = 21).

name.description: Exact property-unit name (your own designation), case-insensitive — returns that one unit, e.g. 'Kontoret Gladan 4'.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

propertyType.description: Property-type id (int, NOT a name); look ids up with fastighetsbenchmark_list_property_types, e.g. 2.

propertyTypeName.description: Property-type by NAME (locale-aware), e.g. 'Office'/'Kontor'; alternative to the numeric propertyType id.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

name: fastighetsbenchmark_search_property_units

address.description: The unit's postal address { streetNameAndNumber, postalCode, postalTown, countryCode }.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry — present ONLY when includeGeometry=true (omitted by default).

code.description: Official municipality code (Sweden: SCB kommunkod), e.g. '0180'.

id.description: Municipality id; use as the municipalityId filter, e.g. 21.

municipality.description: The unit's municipality as { id, name, code }.

id.description: Property-type id; use as the propertyType filter, e.g. 1.

propertyType.description: The unit's property type as { id, name }.

sedisId.description: Stable Comp sedisId; pass to get_comp_timeseries via sedisIdIn, e.g. 'PU-1'.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: Search your property units (Fastighet)
